subject: Renewal: governance review + onboarding slate for Q3 term uplift
messages:
From: Allison Thorne <allison.thorne@globex.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@globex.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: governance review + onboarding slate for Q3 term uplift

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the heads up on the upcoming renewal notice. Globex is planning a modest term uplift for Q3 (targeting a 20% capacity increase) and we want to align procurement and legal early to avoid last-minute stalls. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can you share the latest onboarding slate and a short mutual action plan we can attach to the PO?
2) Legal wants to run a redline against our standard procurement terms; can your team accept a redline and confirm the legal point of contact?

We'd also like to smooth the PO submission so finance can route it the first week of May. If possible, send any SOC2 or data-retention evidence upfront (summary or link is fine).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let me know if I should loop anyone else in.

Thanks,
Allison Thorne
Procurement Manager, Globex Corporation
ProcureOps: procureops@globex.com

Attachments: none in this message
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Thorne <allison.thorne@globex.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@globex.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: governance review + onboarding slate for Q3 term uplift

Allison — thanks, and great to hear Globex is planning the uplift. Quick answer up front: yes, we can accept a standard redline and we've attached an onboarding slate and MAP to accelerate the PO.

Action plan (high level) — please confirm PO target date and we'll work these in parallel:
- Today (May 3): I shared Redwood_Onboarding_Slate_v3.pdf and Mutual_Action_Plan_Globex_Redwood.xlsx (attached) for your procurement and finance teams.
- Legal review: Mark K. (cc'd) will pick up the redline and provide consolidated comments by EOD May 5. If there are narrow term exceptions, we can escalate to commercial.
- SOC2 / evidence: We'll share a summary PDF and a link to the secure evidence bundle below.
- PO smoothing: If you can submit a provisional PO in the portal, we can pre-stage resource allocation so capacity is ready upon signature. Link: https://procure.globex.com/PO/submit/GLX-7891

Notes / attachments included: Redwood_Onboarding_Slate_v3.pdf (checklist + timeline), Mutual_Action_Plan_Globex_Redwood.xlsx (tasks + owners). Expect a separate email from Aditya with pricing confirmation and the deal id.

Let me know your preferred legal contact and any addl constraints (vendor-evidence retention, on-prem requirement, etc.).

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Slate_v3.pdf (application onboarding checklist), Mutual_Action_Plan_Globex_Redwood.xlsx (MAP)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Thorne <allison.thorne@globex.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: governance review + onboarding slate for Q3 term uplift

Hi Allison / team — looping in pricing.

We have provisionally priced the 20% capacity uplift under deal RW-GLX-2026-091. If Globex confirms the PO by May 7 we can lock the current tiered rate (no step-up), otherwise the next-rate band kicks in on June 1.

A few operational clarifications:
- Capacity start date: We propose July 1 to align with Q3 usage patterns; if you need earlier, we can spin up a temporary burst pool.
- Billing: Monthly in arrears, with the PO referencing the renewal addendum number A-2026-GLX.
- Legal redline: Markus is taking lead on the redline review. Please send your marked-up terms to markus_klein@redwood.ai and he'll consolidate.

I'll add pricing notes to the MAP and send a short pricing addendum if you prefer it embedded in the PO.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_note_RW-GLX-2026-091.txt (summary in email body)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Thorne <allison.thorne@globex.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: governance review + onboarding slate for Q3 term uplift

Allison — thanks for sending the sample terms earlier today (received via ProcureOps). I reviewed and applied a narrow redline focused on liability caps, data handling annex, and termination notice timing. I've uploaded our consolidated mark-up: redline_terms_Globex_Redwood_2026.docx (attached).

Summary of key points we expect to agree quickly:
- Liability cap: standard mutual cap at 1x annualized fees (no change).
- Data retention: Globex needs a 7-year retention view for audit logs; we're proposing a secure export process rather than storing everything in the private tenant (details in annex).
- Termination notice: proposing 60 days notice for convenience term adjustments.

Next steps:
1) If these are acceptable, ProcureOps can submit a provisional PO in the portal (https://procure.globex.com/PO/submit/GLX-7891) and indicate that Redwood has accepted the redline (subject to final signature).
2) Stephanie / Aditya will confirm resource staging and billing addendum.
3) We'll share a short SOC2 summary (SOC2_Report_2025_summary.pdf) for your legal pack.

Looking forward to confirmation so we can schedule onboarding for the week of June 22.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_terms_Globex_Redwood_2026.docx
